conversion.assetModel: two separate images: Start and Movement
conversion.style: charcoal background, black clothing, off-white figure/equipment, orange primary emphasis, muted blue secondary emphasis, grey-green stabilizers
conversion.sharedPromptTemplate: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fitness 7 mobile exercise guidance artwork. Create one instructional image for {EXERCISE_NAME}, showing only the {PHASE_NAME} position. Scene: minimal charcoal gym environment, nearly black background, subtle floor contact and restrained depth, no decorative clutter. Subject: one adult athlete with realistic athletic proportions demonstrating the exact exercise, equipment, grip, stance, joint position, and range described by the source row. Equipment: {EXACT_EQUIPMENT}. Phase position: {PHASE_INSTRUCTION}. Grip and stance: {GRIP_AND_STANCE}. Anatomy emphasis: primary muscles {PRIMARY_MUSCLES} highlighted with restrained Fitness 7 orange; secondary muscles {SECONDARY_MUSCLES} with muted blue; stabilizers {STABILIZER_MUSCLES} indicated subtly in desaturated grey-green. Style: premium realistic 3D scientific fitness illustration, consistent Fitness 7 black and orange visual language. Composition: square 1:1, full athlete and equipment visible, centered with at least 10 percent clear margin, camera angle {CAMERA_ANGLE}. Lighting: controlled high-contrast studio lighting with clear separation from charcoal. Constraints: one athlete, one pose, one exercise, one phase; no split view, collage, title text, instructional text, logo, watermark, external branding, unrelated equipment, cropped hands/feet/weights/cables/benches/bars/machines, distorted anatomy, mirrored equipment, or duplicate phase pose. Avoid white background, EvolutionFit branding, exaggerated muscle size, decorative orange graphics, incorrect grip, incorrect bench angle, and unnamed equipment.
conversion.startSuffix: Phase name: Start. Show the stable starting position before the repetition begins. Make equipment placement, grip, stance, bench or machine adjustment, posture, and joint stacking immediately understandable. Do not show the peak contraction or movement arrows. The athlete must look ready to begin.
conversion.movementSuffix: Phase name: Movement. Use the approved Start image as the visual identity reference. Keep the same athlete, clothing, equipment, camera angle, lighting, and background. Show the peak working or clearly active position. Make it visibly different from Start through meaningful joint and equipment movement. Where helpful, use one restrained orange directional cue that does not cover the athlete. Do not show the original Start pose.
outputTreatment: Generate one square image per phase; never generate a split view.
Contain-resize proportionally to 512x512 and pad with the approved charcoal background.
Never stretch or crop the athlete or equipment.
Save Start and Movement as separate PNG files.
